patch.summary:
Choose Microsoft 365 Copilot only if your buying job matches “Workspace LLM assistant add-on — Copilot Business from $21/user/mo annual; Enterprise add-” rather than Zapier's shape. Choose Zapier only if your buying job matches “Automation + AI — Free 100 tasks; Pro from $19.99/mo annual (750 tasks); Team from 2,000 t” rather than Microsoft 365 Copilot's shape. Workflow advantage: Microsoft 365 Copilot leans llm-assistant; Zapier leans ai-automation.
